// Optional external-producer build metadata, never run by Pulse or offline replay.
use std::process::Command;
fn main() {
    let rustc = std::env::var_os("RUSTC").expect("Cargo supplies RUSTC");
    let version = Command::new(rustc).arg("--version").output().unwrap();
    assert!(version.status.success());
    let version = String::from_utf8(version.stdout).unwrap();
    println!("cargo:rustc-env=PULSE_FIXTURE_RUSTC={}", version.trim());
    println!(
        "cargo:rustc-env=PULSE_FIXTURE_TARGET={}",
        std::env::var("TARGET").unwrap()
    );
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs");
}
